Paighambar! Aap us shai ko kyon tark kar rahe hain jis ko Khuda ne aap ke liye halaal kiya hai. Kya aap azwaaj ki marzi ke khwaahishmand hain, aur Allah bahut bakhshne waala aur meharbaan hai
Khuda ne farz qaraar diya hai ke apni qasam ko kaffaara de kar khatm kar dijiye, aur Allah aap ka Maula hai aur woh har cheez ka jaanne waala aur saahib-e-hikmat hai

Aur jab Nabi ne apni ba'z azwaaj se raaz ki baat bataayi aur us ne doosri ko baakhabar kar diya aur Khuda ne Nabi par zaahir kar diya, to Nabi ne ba'z baaton ko use bataaya aur ba'z se e'raaz kiya. Phir jab use baakhabar kiya to us ne poochha ke aap ko kis ne bataaya hai, to aap ne kaha ke Khuda-e-Aleem o Khabeer ne

Ab tum dono tauba karo ke tumhaare dilon mein kaji paida ho gayi hai, warna agar us ke khilaaf ittifaaq karogi to yaad rakho ke Allah us ka sarparast hai, aur Jibraeel aur nek momineen aur malaaika sab us ke madadgaar hain

Woh agar tumhein talaaq bhi de dega to Khuda tumhaare badle use tum se behtar biwiyaan ata kar dega: muslima, momina, farmaanbardaar, tauba karne waali, ibaadat-guzaar, roza rakhne waali, kunwaari aur ghair-kunwaari sab

Imaan waalo! Apne nafs aur apne ahl ko us aag se bachaao jis ka eendhan insaan aur patthar honge, jis par woh malaaika mu'ayyan honge jo sakht-mizaaj aur tund o tez hain, aur Khuda ke hukm ki mukhaalifat nahin karte hain, aur jo hukm diya jaata hai usi par amal karte hain
Aur aye kufr ikhtiyaar karne waalo! Aaj koi uzr pesh na karo ke aaj tumhein tumhaare aamaal ki saza di jaaegi

Imaan waalo! Khuloos-e-dil ke saath tauba karo. Anqareeb tumhaara Parwardigar tumhaari buraaiyon ko mita dega aur tumhein un jannaton mein daakhil kar dega jin ke neeche nahrein jaari hongi. Us din Khuda apne Nabi aur saahibaan-e-imaan ko ruswa nahin hone dega. Un ka noor un ke aage aage aur daahini taraf chal raha hoga aur woh kahenge ke Khudaaya! Hamaare liye hamaare noor ko mukammal kar de aur humein bakhsh de ke tu yaqeenan har shai par qudrat rakhne waala hai
Paighambar! Aap kuffaar aur munaafiqeen se jihaad karein aur un par sakhti karein, aur un ka thikaana Jahannam hai aur wahi badtareen anjaam hai

Khuda ne kufr ikhtiyaar karne waalon ke liye zauja-e-Nooh aur zauja-e-Loot ki misaal bayaan ki hai ke yeh dono hamaare nek bandon ki zaujiyat mein thin lekin un se khiyaanat ki, to us zaujiyat ne Khuda ki baargaah mein koi faaida nahin pahunchaaya, aur un se keh diya gaya ke tum bhi tamaam Jahannam mein daakhil hone waalon ke saath daakhil ho jaao

Aur Khuda ne imaan waalon ke liye Fir'aun ki zauja ki misaal bayaan ki hai ke us ne dua ki ke Parwardigar! Mere liye Jannat mein ek ghar bana de aur mujhe Fir'aun aur us ke kaarobaar se najaat dila de aur is poori zaalim qaum se najaat ata kar de

Aur Maryam binte Imraan alaihas-salaam ki misaal jis ne apni iffat ki hifaazat ki to hum ne us mein apni rooh phoonk di, aur us ne apne Rab ke kalimaat aur kitaabon ki tasdeeq ki, aur woh hamaare farmaanbardaar bandon mein se thi
